<!-- pr-reviewer: cf06258f1f259ede991f7818459bc39e65a60916 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The region checks, island tests, and CL output tests pass. This is a safety review because the change controls cutter paths and posted output. The PR changes no UI files, dependencies, build scripts, or workflow files.

Local results, after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at ca603fc4:

- Test compilation: `cargo test -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --no-run` passed.
- Adaptive trochoid unit tests: 16 passed. After removal of both mutations, all 16 passed again.
- App adaptive trochoid tests: 8 passed. All four CL files match the generated output. Posting checks passed.
- Motion slot tests: 11 passed.
- Clippy for both crates, all targets, with warnings denied: passed.
- Each line in the four CL files was checked for numeric data, move count, cut depth, and arc radius consistency. The pocket-face diff keeps the loop cuts and adds the stated cleanup cuts. No cut goes below the 17 mm floor.

Mutation results:

- Restore the base adaptive planner, with only the helper visibility needed to compile: the wide-pocket test failed. Rest was 364.13 mm2; the HSM reference was 17.61 mm2, with 14.00 mm2 tolerance.
- Bypass cleanup planning: the corner cleanup test failed. Rest was 56.22 mm2; the HSM reference was 17.76 mm2, with 4.72 mm2 tolerance.
- Both mutations were removed. The worktree matches the trial-merge commit.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/adaptive_troch_clean.rs:59`: Keep the cleanup step at or below the selected optimal load. The final `.max(0.08 * r)` raises every selected load below 4% of the tool diameter to 4%. For example, a 6 mm tool with a valid 1% load requests a 0.06 mm step, but cleanup uses 0.24 mm. The parameter door accepts this load. The extra cuts can thus take a larger radial step than the user selected. Remove this lower clamp, or refuse the unsupported load by name. Add a test below 4% that checks cleanup spacing and the complete path. The current tests use the default load and do not check this case.

Note: five geometry tests took more than 60 seconds in debug. The unit test run took 304 seconds, and the restored run took 281 seconds. Consider smaller fixtures for the default test lane.

No GitHub runner was used. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed the latest review finding about cleanup exceeding the selected optimal load.

Cleanup no longer raises a small step with the lower clamp. The complete generator refuses optimal loads below 4% by name before planning. This takes the review's allowed refusal option because low-load complete paths hit the existing crossing checks.

Pin: `machining2d::adaptive_troch::tests::low_load_bounds_cleanup_spacing_and_complete_path`. It checks actual cleanup spacing at 1% and named complete-generator refusals below 4%. Restoring the clamp fails the spacing assertion. Removing the guard fails the refusal assertion. Restoring both fixes passes.

Motion clippy passed for all targets with warnings denied. The requested quick gate is red on `winding_align::the_inside_out_stl_fixture_reads_inside_out_and_refuses`: expected `InsideOut`, got `Outward`. The same exact test fails on the reviewed head with all three fixes removed. Motion suites and all eight app adaptive-trochoid tests passed. No unrelated fix was made.

New head: `104dbc238b380c63f506008fc47cb9f64a86cf14`.

Please re-review. The PR remains a draft.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 104dbc238b380c63f506008fc47cb9f64a86cf14 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety review. The change controls cutter paths and posted output. The previous requested change is complete: cleanup does not increase the selected step, and the complete generator refuses optimal loads below 4% by name. No blocking items were found.

Local results after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at a39e9a8b42cca07a1ef098a932e71aab02a4b8ee:

- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --no-run`: passed.
- Motion adaptive trochoid unit tests: 17 passed.
- App adaptive trochoid tests: 8 passed. All four CL files match the generated output. Stock checks and posting passed.
- Motion slot tests: 11 passed.
- App trochoid confinement tests: 6 passed. App trochoid law tests: 7 passed. App trochoid operation tests: 5 passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

I ran two mutations on the low-load test:

1. Restore the lower cleanup clamp. The test failed: `1% cleanup front advanced too far: 2.22`.
2. Remove the low-load guard. The test failed because the error did not give the required low-load refusal. It instead reported crossing moves 2241 and 2248.

Both mutations were removed. The restored low-load test passed. The worktree then matched the trial merge.

I checked each line in the four CL files for numeric data, move count, cut depth, feed, and arc radius consistency. All 18,390 lines passed these checks. No move goes below the 17 mm floor. The pocket-face diff keeps the loop cuts and adds the stated cleanup cuts. The generation tests also check exact output, confinement, engagement, rest stock, and posting.

The PR changes no UI files, dependencies, build scripts, or workflow files. No screenshots are required. The full quick gate was planned but was not run; the tests above cover the changed paths. Release tests and physical machining were not run. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
